comparison.objective: Extract a terminal; record transfers a wafer with tweezers and locks its carrier.
comparison.physical_skill: Lock-tab release and coupled pulling versus edge-only wafer handling, precision seating, carrier assembly, and counterclockwise twist locking.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits intact without neighboring release versus wafer centered and flat, carrier seated and rotated through its lock range, hands clear, with strict no-touch/drop gates. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The record tests fragile planar handling and twist-lock closure rather than depinning.
